summary: Obfuscated agent opens remote-controlled shell/PTY to publisher WebSocket gateway
details: @whalent/agent is a heavily obfuscated Node daemon (dist/index.cjs and ~13 MB dist/core.cjs packed with javascript-obfuscator string-array + rotate + decoder wrappers, identifiers `_0xNNNN` / `a0_0xf1be`) that, once launched via its bin with a user token, connects out to a Whalent-controlled WebSocket gateway (default `wss://memory.whalent.com`). The bundle imports `child_process` and `node-pty` and wires WebSocket `onmessage` handlers into shell spawn/write sinks, and the package README states the agent "accepts remote commands (upgrade, restart) via the gateway." This gives the remote party at the gateway an interactive shell / PTY on the installer's host under the invoking user's account. A secondary channel constructs `npm install` invocations (`npmInstallCommand` / `preferredNpmRegistry`, default `registry.npmjs.org` with a China-registry alternate) reachable via the gateway's documented `upgrade` command, allowing the remote server to trigger installation of additional npm packages on the host. Full-runtime obfuscation conceals the exact dispatcher mapping gateway messages to shell writes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
